title: Is Art Created by Using Claude to Write Blender Scripts AI Slop ?
author: Patient-Sprinkles920
selftext: Serious question. If I guide the look and feel until I am satisfied with the art, is it still AI slop ? Should it be disclosed as AI art ?

Art is not pixels, nor a realistic drawing .It is teh transmition of a message a feeling what you want to be seen, AI slop is when thre is no message, only like a bad meat hamburguer , no message, just a mess, if you maange to make it feel like a thing, then you ahve made art

You are asking two very different questions, and it almost feels like you are trying to justify the later.

Not everything generated by AI is slop.

But YES you must disclose art generated by AI.

replies.author: Pleasant_Salt6810
replies.body:
If you hit "generate" on a 3D AI generator (like Meshy or Tripo3D) that outputs a finished 3D mesh directly from a prompt, **that is an AI asset**. But if an LLM helps you write a Python loop that extrudes a cylinder in Blender, **that is an AI-assisted toolchain**, not an AI asset.

It's a tool, the ouput is human verified , it's AI-assisted.

comments.author: santigv1500
comments.body:
I think it should be disclosed as AI art, mainly because if people like your game and later find out that you used AI and lied about it, you'll lose all your credibility.

I've been reading posts and comments from people who are against AI generated art, and the main argument they bring up is that AI is trained on other people's existing work. So, in their view, even if you carefully guide the AI, you're essentially combining styles and ideas from other artists.

Personally, I don't entirely agree with that perspective. Throughout history, artists and game developers have constantly drawn inspiration from existing works, added their own vision, and improved upon those ideas. In that sense, I don't think AI assisted creation is fundamentally that different, especially when there's genuine creative direction and effort involved. By the way, I think AI slop is something entirely different. To me, AI slop is generic, soulless content that can be generated with a single prompt, without much thought, creativity, attention to detail, or artistic vision behind it.
